title: VERIFY: No Convex function accepts spoofable user ID
description: Code review verification - ensure NO query or mutation in convex/ accepts a user identifier (visitorId, userId, email) as an argument. All user identification must come from ctx.auth.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Grep convex/*.ts for 'visitorId: v.string()' - should find ONLY migration.ts
Grep convex/*.ts for 'userId: v.string()' in args - should find NONE
Grep convex/*.ts for 'email: v.string()' in args for user lookup - should find NONE
Verify wordProgress.ts uses getAuthUserId/requireAuth, not args
Verify userSongProgress.ts uses getAuthUserId/requireAuth, not args
Verify lineProgress.ts uses getAuthUserId/requireAuth, not args
Verify userWishlist.ts uses getAuthUserId/requireAuth, not args
Verify userPracticeLog.ts uses getAuthUserId/requireAuth, not args
Verify userGoals.ts uses getAuthUserId/requireAuth, not args
Verify userPreferences.ts uses getAuthUserId/requireAuth, not args
Verify leaderboard.ts uses getAuthUserId/requireAuth, not args

notes:
CODE REVIEW - NO BROWSER NEEDED.

Run these commands to verify:
```bash
# Should return ONLY migration.ts (for migration flow)
grep -r 'visitorId: v.string()' convex/

# Should return NOTHING
grep -r 'userId: v.string()' convex/ | grep -v 'by_user'

# Check that all user data files import authHelpers
grep -l 'from.*authHelpers' convex/*.ts
```

EXCEPTION: migration.ts is allowed to accept visitorId because:
1. User provides their OWN localStorage ID
2. Data is copied TO their authenticated account
3. ctx.auth still validates the destination user
